cc:Work.dc:title: StorageShelf
cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageShelf can be used to store Typetray
This is a simple shelf box.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageShelf --FingerJoint_style=rectangular --FingerJoint_surroundingspaces=0.5 --FingerJoint_bottom_lip=0.0
